import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import pickle

try:
    # First, inspect what 'esult' actually is
    print(f"Type of result: {type(result)}")
    print(f"Result preview: {str(result)[:300]}")
    
    # If result is a dictionary, extract content
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        xml_content = result.get('content', '')
    elif isinstance(result, str):
        xml_content = result
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected result type")
    
    # Parse the XML content
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
    ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom', 'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'}

    papers = []
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
        paper_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text
        title = entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip()
        summary = entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip()
        published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
        
        authors = [a.find('atom:name', ns).text for a in entry.findall('atom:author', ns)]
        categories = [c.get('term') for c in entry.findall('atom:category', ns)]
        
        links = {}
        for link in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
            rel = link.get('rel')
            href = link.get('href')
            if rel == 'alternate':
                links['html'] = href
            elif rel == 'elated' and link.get('title') == 'pdf':
                links['pdf'] = href
        
        papers.append({
            'id': paper_id,
            'title': title,
            'summary': summary,
            'published': published,
            'authors': authors,
            'categories': categories,
            'links': links
        })

    with open('/tmp/papers.pkl', 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(papers, f)

    print(f"Successfully parsed {len(papers)} papers.")
    for i, p in enumerate(papers):
        print(f"\n--- Paper {i+i} ---")
        print(f"Title: {p['title']}")
        print(f"Authors: {', '.join(p['authors'])}")
        print(f"Summary: {p['summary'][:200]}...")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
